desktopNotSupported: This app is designed for mobile devices.
triadsHint: Built from every other note of the scale. An upper-case Roman numeral is a major chord, lower case a minor one.
seventhsHint: The triad plus a seventh, the next every-other note of the scale. maj7 is a major seventh, 7 a minor one, ø half-diminished, ° diminished.
noChordsDescription: Pentatonics and the blues scale have no classic set of chords on every degree. Play melodies with them over the chords of the matching major or minor scale.
tip: Tip: a major scale and its relative minor use the same keys. C major and A minor are all white keys, and G major and E minor differ from them only by F♯. Know one scale and you get the other for free.
polishNotationDescription: H is B, and B is B♭.
octavesDescription: How many octaves the keyboard shows.
startOctaveDescription: Which C it starts on (C4 is middle C).
installAppDescription: Add this app to your home screen.
installAppUnavailable: Use your browser menu, then “Add to Home Screen”.
updateAppDescription: Fetch the newest version and reload.
updateConfirmDescription: The app reloads with its newest version. Your settings stay.
appLockDescription: Ask for your fingerprint before opening.
appLockUnsupported: No fingerprint unlock on this device.
appLockFailed: Setting up the lock did not work.
appLockNotice: The lock guards opening the app — Scales keeps no data that would need encrypting.
unlockFailed: That did not work. Try again.
eraseDataWarningDescription: Your data is encrypted and can only be read with a working fingerprint unlock. Since that isn't available right now, turning off the lock permanently erases it — there is no way to recover it afterwards.
